title: Implicit Bias in LLMs: A Survey
findings: A cited study by Zhao (2024) found that GPT-4 was more likely to recommend applicants with Arab/Muslim names for lower-status jobs compared to applicants with White names for higher-status positions, indicating implicit bias.
